heroHeadline: Tinubu Returns to Nigeria After Four-Week European Working Vacation
heroSubtitle: President Tinubu landed in Lagos on September 29 after four weeks in London and Paris, a stay extended beyond the announced three weeks. He said he is healthy and ready to resume work, and is set to attend the Abiola film premiere on Independence Day and hold strategy meetings ahead of the 2027 elections.
